allocations.rationale: Directly resolves a contested literature contradiction regarding early macular atrophy versus late rod-cone degeneration across the Smirnov and Ku cohorts, yielding exact cohort numerators/denominators.
Resolves the explicit conflict between Sakti and Wright/Kuper cohorts over dark-adapted electronegative ERG sensitivity as an objective functional differentiator from STGD1 and typical RP.
